entries.line: A picture opened whole, zoomed and moved by wheel, drag, pinch, double press and buttons.
entries.example:
<ImageViewer
  v-model:open="open"
  :src="pictures[at]!.src"
  :title="pictures[at]!.name"
  :can-previous="at > 0"
  :can-next="at < pictures.length - 1"
  @previous="at -= 1"
  @next="at += 1"
>
  <template #actions>
    <UButton icon="i-material-symbols-download" color="neutral" variant="ghost" :aria-label="t('notes.action.download')" :href="pictures[at]!.src" download />
  </template>
</ImageViewer>

entries.line: A setting's own form as a dialog, asking before it closes on changes.
entries.example:
<SettingsDialog v-model:open="open" :title="t('notes.title.rename_folder')" :dirty="name !== saved">
  <UFormField :label="t('notes.label.name')">
    <UInput v-model="name" class="w-full" />
  </UFormField>

  <template #footer="{ close }">
    <UButton color="neutral" variant="ghost" :label="t('common.action.cancel')" @click="close" />
    <UButton :label="t('common.action.save')" @click="(saved = name), (open = false)" />
  </template>
</SettingsDialog>
